statement: ∀ b D : ℝ≥0∞, D < ⊤ → (∀ q : ℝ, D < ENNReal.ofReal q → b ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q + 1)) → b ≤ D + 1
proof:
intro b D hD h
by_contra hb
have hDb : D + 1 < b := lt_of_not_ge hb
obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha, hab⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hDb
have hplus : ENNReal.ofReal (D.toReal + 1) = D + 1 := by
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add ENNReal.toReal_nonneg zero_le_one, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hD.ne, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
have haR : D.toReal + 1 < a := by
  rw [← hplus] at ha
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mp ha
have hq : D < ENNReal.ofReal (a - 1) :=
  (ENNReal.lt_ofReal_iff_toReal_lt hD.ne).mpr (by linarith)
have hb' := h (a - 1) hq
have heq : a - 1 + 1 = a := by ring
rw [heq] at hb'
exact (not_lt_of_ge hb') hab

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Set (GDVec m)),
      0 ≤ dimH A ∧
        ∀ (s : ℝ),
          0 < s →
            GDMeasure s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → GDMeasure s A = ∞) ∧
                (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → GDMeasure s A = 0) ∧
                  (GDMeasure s A < ∞ → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧
                    (GDMeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (GDMeasure s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) →
    Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
        0 ≤ dimH E ∧
          dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
            dimH E < ∞ ∧ (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GDContent s δ E < ∞) ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0) →
      (dimH GDInterval = 1 ∧
          (∀ (a : ℝ), 1 < a → GDMeasure a GDInterval = 0) ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → 0 < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ (s - 1)) ≤ GDContent s δ GDInterval) ∧
              ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → GDMeasure s GDInterval = ∞) →
        (1 ≤ n → ∀ (q r ε : ℝ), dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → 0 < ε → GDPositiveCover E q r ε) →
          ((∀ (x y : GDVec n) (t u : ℝ), dist (GDPoint x t) (GDPoint y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
              ∀ (z : GDVec (n + 1)), ∃ x t, z = GDPoint x t) →
            ∀ (b D : ℝ≥0∞), D < ∞ → (∀ (q : ℝ), D < ENNReal.ofReal q → b ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q + 1)) → b ≤ D + 1
